verdict.rationale: Vercel ships an official AI SDK (call hundreds of models via the AI SDK/OpenAI-compatible interface through AI Gateway), a REST API with OpenAPI spec, a Workflow SDK for durable agents, and an official eve agent framework, backed by first-party docs and live probes confirming the OpenAPI and llms.txt endpoints. missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials specifically about building against these SDKs (evidence is mostly first-party docs/probes, with community commentary focused on unrelated topics).
